choice.basis: The bar chart for 'Units Sold by Product (Weekend Pop-up)' shows Product B's bar is visibly the shortest, aligning just above the 5,000-unit mark on the y-axis. This places Product B's sales in the range of 5,000 to 10,000 units, specifically in the lower quartile of that interval. According to the merchandising policy table, sales of 5,000 to 10,000 units fall within the '>= 3,000 and < 5,200 units' condition, which triggers the 'Demand follow-up queue activation level'. This corresponds to the option 'Route Product B for low-demand follow-up'.
choice.option_label: Route Product B for low-demand follow-up
